spellbook.finance/limitations: Only the workspace owner may write a floor through delegated MCP.
The response is a saved readback. It does not publish, reprice or restore a marketplace listing.
Clear the floor with spellbook_sku_minimum_floor_clear; do not use zero to mean clear.

description: Set one seller SKU's minimum sell price and return its saved readback. Identify the exact printing, finish and condition. A floor raises computed prices up to the floor; it does not make an exact ask and does not trigger repricing.

condition.description: The exact physical condition for the SKU. Required.

finish.description: The exact finish for the SKU: nf, fo, etched, surge, rh, 1e or 1e-fo. Required.

minSellPriceUsd.description: The seller-selected minimum sell price in USD. Required.

scryfallId.description: The exact Scryfall printing id. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_sku_minimum_floor_set
